guide.title: Tyrael's Overview
guide.text:
Tyrael is a melee Tank, whose great mobility allows him to get in
and out of combat very quickly. With his unique kit, he can support allied Heroes
in various ways: Shielding them, giving them Movement Speed, and more. On the other hand,
compared to his counterparts, Tyrael lacks crowd control
and thus cannot easily punish enemy Heroes who are out of position.

guide.title: Tyrael's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Supports allied Heroes with Movement Speed and Shields
Exceptional mobility
Reduces enemy waveclear, especially with Justice for All
Good engage with Judgment
Great protection for allied Heroes with Sanctification
Good waveclear with Burning Halo
Able to secure Capture Points with Holy Ground
High damage output for his Role, augmentable with dedicated Talents
Weaknesses
Lack of crowd control
Extremely Mana dependent throughout the game
Weak engage outside of Judgment
Time Stop can nullify Sanctification

Tyrael's Basic Attacks Build provides self-sustain
in combat, more damage, and waveclear.
With it, you will be able to harass enemy Heroes.
The self-sustain mainly comes from Ardent Restoration
at Level 1 and is increased by Burning Halo at Level 7
which makes its healing ramp up faster at the beginning of a team fight.
Reciprocate at Level 4 also heals you a bit.
The waveclear comes from Burning Halo at Level 7,
which passively deals area of effect damage,
increased when teleporting with El'druin's Might.
Once you get Sword of Justice at Level 13,
your playstyle will be drastically different:
use El'druin's Might, reactivate it to reach enemy Heroes,
deal damage to them, and then reactivate it again to teleport back.
When not playing against Garrosh, you can pick Holy Ground
at Level 13 for blocking the path of enemy Heroes in narrow corridors
or to secure Capture Points. Combine it with
Horadric Reforging at Level 16 for cooldown reduction.

guide.title: Tyrael's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Tyrael synergizes with
Tyrael has synergy with allied Heroes who want to
dive (such as Kerrigan),
lack mobility (like Alarak),
or want to constantly hit enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks
(for example Valla).
Due to his lack of crowd control
outside of Judgment, we suggest pairing
Tyrael with Heroes who have some crowd control for helping
to engage and/or peel.
You can play without too, however, it is easier with.
Together with Lt. Morales, Tyrael is a fundamental piece of
the famous Juice Pirates team composition. This backdoor
strategy relies on Medivac Dropships
to quickly reach enemy Structures as a team and
Sanctification to push
uncontested, unless they have a counter for it.
Tyrael is countered by
Tyrael with Judgment is countered by
Heroes who can protect the targeted Hero with Shields and similar effects
(notably Medivh with Force of Will), who can
quickly deny the dive with disengage tools
(for example Mighty Gust by Falstad),
or who have access to cleanse effects (such as
Purge by Rehgar).
Tyrael with Sanctification is countered by
Heroes who can interrupt it, protect Heroes during it
(for example Bunker Drop by Blaze), or nullify it
by using Time Stop on the Heroes protected by it
(only Medivh, Mei, and Zeratul can do it,
with Ley Line Seal, Ice Wall,
and Void Prison respectively).
Tyrael with Holy Ground is countered by
displacement effects (notably Mighty Gust
by Falstad) as it will mainly be used to secure Boss Camp
by standing on the Capture Point uncontested.
For obvious reasons, this part is only relevant on Maps where Boss Camps
are a win condition.

guide.title: Tyrael's Maps
guide.text:
Tyrael's stronger maps
Tyrael's average maps
Tyrael's weaker maps
Thanks to Holy Ground at Level 13
being usable to block the path of enemy Heroes, Tyrael excels
on Maps where Boss Camps are a
win condition and does well
on Maps with narrow corridors around the Objective.
Tyrael's Heroic Abilities are extremely powerful in team fights.
Considering that both Judgment and
Sanctification have a relatively long cooldown,
Tyrael does better on Maps where team fights do not happen too often,
so that he has time to get them back before fighting again.

guide.title: Tyrael's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Use your Abilities wisely while laning. If you are not careful, Tyrael will run out of Mana very quickly.
El'druin's Might can be used to juke opponents while Tyrael is on the retreat.
Righteousness should be used right before Tyrael, allied Heroes, Minions, or Mercenaries are being hit.
Smite can be used to deal damage and/or to increase the Movement Speed of allied Heroes when needed.
Judgment is great for diving but can also be used to interrupt powerful Heroic Abilities.
If you play with Sanctification, use it when diving with your team or save it for the enemy team's most dangerous Abilities.
Upon dying, you will trigger Archangel's Wrath. Stick on top of enemy Heroes to reduce their damage done and for hitting them with the explosion.
After picking Swift Retribution at Level 7, you should mainly use Smite on allied Heroes to buff them.
Holy Ground at Level 13 can help you secure Mercenary Camps (especially Boss Camps) if El'druin's Might is aimed at the very center of the Capture Point.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Tyrael's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Tyrael is a Tank that excels at enabling allied Heroes
who want to dive, lack mobility,
or want to constantly hit enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks.
He has access to powerful Heroic Abilities that do completely different things:
Judgment can be used either for diving
or as an interrupt when your team is lacking them;
Sanctification can be used for diving,
peeling, enabling a strong push
with allied Heroes, or countering specific Abilities.
Thanks to Holy Ground at Level 13,
Tyrael is one of the best Heroes for securing Capture Points.
This is quite strong on Maps where Boss Camps
are a win condition.
Sanctification also helps with that
because it is great when fighting in a static position.

abilities.title: El'druin's Might
abilities.text:
El'druin's Might
(Q)
Tyrael
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Throw El'druin to the target area, dealing 110 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds. It can be reactivated within 5 seconds to teleport Tyrael to El'druin and Slow nearby enemies again.
El'druin's Might is a Basic Ability that can be cast
to put a sword on the ground and then reactivated within 5 seconds to teleport there.
Enemies hit by the sword take damage. Enemies hit by the sword or near the teleport
location when Tyrael appears are Slowed. You can use it
offensively, defensively, or even for scouting.
The offensive usage primarily relies on the fact that
El'druin's Might applies a moderate Slow
to enemies hit by the sword or near the teleport location when Tyrael appears,
allowing you to body block them and your whole team
to hit them more easily. Since it is your main mobility tool,
remember that using El'druin's Might to enage
leaves you without an escape.
The defensive usage is mostly based on the fact that
El'druin's Might allows you to teleport from a location
to another, even over impassable terrain,
enemy Heroes, and other obstacles. To maximise your chances to survive in difficult
situations, throw the sword in a direction and run in the opposite way, so that the
opponents will have to choose between following you or moving towards the sword.
If there are more enemies on you than around the sword, it is better to reactivate it,
else you should prefer just running away. Keep in mind that
crowd control will not let you reactivate it.
The scouting usage is possible because you can choose to not reactivate
El'druin's Might after casting it. If there is a dangerous
bush to check and no one of your teammates can give vision
there, you can throw your sword there to get vision. If you see enemy Heroes
and it is a good fight to take, you can teleport, otherwise just wait for
the reactivation to time out without using it.

abilities.title: Righteousness
abilities.text:
Righteousness
(W)
Tyrael
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 9 seconds
Shields Tyrael for 350 damage and nearby allied Heroes and Minions for 40% as much for 4 seconds.
Righteousness is a Basic Ability that gives a
temporary Shield to Tyrael and all allied Heroes and Minions within 5 range.
Since the Shield expires after 4 seconds, this effect should ideally
be used right before you, allied Heroes or Minions take damage. To get more
value out of it, position in a way to Shield as many units as possible.
The fact you can Shield allied Minions with it is great for reducing
the enemy team's waveclear.

abilities.title: Smite
abilities.text:
Smite
(E)
Tyrael
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 6 seconds
Rake target area, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage. For the next 3 seconds, allies moving through the targeted area gain 25% increased Movement Speed for 2 seconds.
Smite is a Basic Ability that deals damage
to enemies hit and creates a buff area on the ground:
Tyrael and allied units who step on it gain Movement Speed. This effect is
useful to chase, reposition in team fights,
body block, dodge,
and escape. When appropriate, use it help allied Heroes who lack
mobility (notably Sgt. Hammer).

abilities.title: Judgment
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Judgment
(R)
Tyrael
Heroic
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 70 seconds
After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.
Judgment is a Heroic Ability that, after being
channeled for 0.75 seconds, allows Tyrael to quickly close the gap
with a target enemy Hero. The target takes damage and is Stunned.
Allies nearby the target take some damage too and are Knocked back.
Last but not the least, Tyrael becomes Unstoppable while
charging towards the target.
Due to the fact it needs to be channeled for 0.75 seconds,
Judgment should ideally be cast when Tyrael is not near
enemy Heroes who have access to interrupts, unless you know
they are on cooldown and thus can safely cast it. Judgment
will go on a 10-second cooldown when Tyrael is interrupted, the target moves 5 range
outside of the maximum range or becomes invalid during the wind-up period.
To choose the right target, pay attention to the tools that each enemy Hero
has at their disposal and go for the most vulnerable ones. If your are not playing
a dive composition, do not go too deep in the enemy
team or your teammates will not be able to follow-up.

abilities.title: Sanctification
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Sanctification
(R)
Tyrael
Heroic
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 85 seconds
After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.
Sanctification is a Heroic Ability that, after being
channeled for 0.5 seconds, creates a buff area
on the ground: Tyrael and allied Heroes who are standing in it
are Invulnerable.
A well-timed Sanctification can single-handedly
decide the outcome of a team fight, so it is crucial to
know how to use it correctly when playing as Tyrael. You can use it to:
peel for allied Heroes when the enemy team is being aggressive,
so that your team can survive and counter-engage;
negate or remove enemy crowd control effects, especially
when they are affecting multiple Heroes (like Ring of Frost by Jaina);
dive together with an allied Hero, so that neither of you can be stopped by
enemy crowd control effects for a few seconds;
protect your whole team from damage and crowd control effects
while taking down an enemy Keep or the enemy Core, so that you cannot be contested.

abilities.title: Archangel's Wrath
abilities.text:
Archangel's Wrath
(D)
Tyrael
Upon dying, become Invulnerable and gain 20% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Upon expiration, explode, dealing 450 (+4% per level) damage and reducing Tyrael's death timer by 10% per enemy Hero hit.
Archangel's Wrath reduces nearby enemy Heroes' damage by 50% while active and for 3 seconds when it expires.
Archangel's Wrath is a Trait that allows you to command Tyrael
for a few seconds after he dies. During that period, you can move but cannot use Abilities.
At the end of that period, an explosion will hit all enemies withing range. Enemies hit
by the explosion take damage. Heroes hit by the explosion reduce your Death Timer.
Heroes who are near Tyrael during Archangel's Wrath deal less
damage and Heroes who get hit by the explosion have their damage reduced for a few seconds.
When you die, you should quickly decide what is the best way to use your Trait.
Here is a priority list to help you with that.
If your team is trying to end the game, deal damage to the enemy Core.
While fighting, deal damage to enemy Heroes who have extremely low Health, hopefully killing them.
Reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes who are trying to kill allied Heroes (prioritize
Ranged Asassins and Melee Assassins).
Deal damage to enemy Minions, Mercenaries, or Monsters in lane for protecting allied Structures.
Try to hit as many enemy Heroes as possible to reduce your Death Timer by more seconds.
In addition to the situations listed above, there are also some Map-specific
interactions that are useful to know.
If you think it can help your team to secure the Immortal, when contesting
the Objective on Battlefield of Eternity, deal damage to the Immortal.
If you think it can help your team to secure the Shrine, when contesting
the Objective on Infernal Shrines, try to last-hit Guardians.

Divine Vigor (Level 4) Tyrael If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.

Sanctification (Level 10) Tyrael Mana: 70 Cooldown: 85 seconds After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.

Holy Ground (Level 13) Tyrael Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.

Law and Order (Level 13) Tyrael Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.

Smite the Wicked (Level 16) Tyrael While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.

Holy Arena (Level 20) Tyrael Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.
Seal of El'druin (Level 20) Tyrael Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.

Defense of the Angels (Level 20) Tyrael Cooldown: 60 seconds Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds. Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.
Aspect of Justice (Level 20) Tyrael After 1.25 seconds, gain the effects of Archangel's Wrath without dying. Cooldown is reduced by 15% for each enemy Hero hit by the explosion.

deal damage to them, and then reactivate it again to teleport back.
When not playing against Garrosh, you can pick Holy Ground
at Level 13 for blocking the path of enemy Heroes in narrow corridors
or to secure Capture Points. Combine it with
Horadric Reforging at Level 16 for cooldown reduction.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
?
Salvation
(Level 1)
Tyrael
Increase the Shield amount Tyrael gains from Righteousness by 35% and heal Tyrael for 150 (+4% per level) Health if his Shield is destroyed. Does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.
Salvation is a decent Talent that increases
the amount of Shield applied to Tyrael by Righteousness
and, when the Shield is destroyed by damage, heals Tyrael. Note that
this Talent does not increase the Shield amount gained by allies.
The healing provided by this Talent is not reliable because it only goes off
when the Shield is destroyed by damage, which does not always happen unless
the enemy team has a lot of burst damage and you time
Righteousness to Shield yourself right before being hit.
Pick this Talent when you want to increase your own survivability in short
team fights at the cost of peeling for allied Heroes
and the possibility to reduce the enemy team's waveclear.
?
Justice for All
(Level 1)
Tyrael
Increase the Shield applied to allies by Righteousness to 80% of the Shield gained by Tyrael.
Justice for All is a strong Talent that greatly increases
the amount of Shield applied to allied Heroes by Righteousness,
increasing their survivability. Note that this Talent does not increase
the Shield amount gained by Tyrael.
Pick this Talent when you want to increases your team's survivability by casting
Righteousness on allied Heroes right before they take damage
and/or to reduce the enemy team's waveclear by casting
Righteousness on allied Minions right before they take damage
(useful in the 4-man and for some offlane matchups).
✔
Ardent Restoration
(Level 1)
Tyrael
Dealing damage to a Hero heals Tyrael for 20 (+4% per level) Health over 5 seconds. Dealing damage resets this timer, and the heal amount stacks up to 8 times.
Quest: Every Regeneration Globe gathered increases this heal amount by 1%.
Ardent Restoration is a strong Talent which
provides self-healing over time when dealing damage to enemy Heroes.
The effect lasts 5 seconds and stacks up to 10 times. The healing
amount is increased 1% for each Regeneration Globe you collect
during the game.
Pick this Talent when you want to increase your own survivability in long
team fights at the cost of peeling for allied Heroes
and the possibility to reduce the enemy team's waveclear.

talent_pages.title: Level 4 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
?
Stalwart Angel
(Level 4)
Tyrael
Gain 25 Armor while El'druin's Might is active, and for 3 seconds after teleporting.
Stalwart Angel is a good Talent that
provides Armor while you have a
El'druin's Might's sword on the ground
and for 3 seconds after teleporting, reducing the damage you
take when you engage or disengage.
The Armor provided by this Talent lasts longer
if you do not quickly reactivate El'druin's Might.
So, if you are in a situation where you need more survivability
than mobility, you should strategically
place your sword on the ground and not teleport immediately.
The sword you leave behind when teleporting in while having
Sword of Justice at Level 13 also
counts for benefitting from this Talent, effectively
extending the Armor buff's duration by 2 seconds when you
do not reactivate El'druin's Might.
Reducing El'druin's Might's cooldown via
Horadric Reforging at Level 16
increases the Armor's uptime.
This is quite useful when playing as Tank
with Holy Ground at Level 13 and trying
to body-block enemy Heroes.
✔
Reciprocate
(Level 4)
Tyrael
When Tyrael's Shield from Righteousness expires or is destroyed, it deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Heroes and Summons.
For each enemy Hero damaged by Reciprocate or El'Druin's Might, Tyrael heals for 3% of his maximum Health.
Reciprocate is a strong Talent that causes
Righteousness's Shield to explode when it
expires (after 4 seconds) or is destroyed by damage. The explosion
deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Summons. Furthermore, damaging
enemy Heroes with Reciprocate's explosion
or El'druin's Might heals Tyrael based on
the amount of enemy Heroes hit.
If you intend to pick Judgment
as your Heroic Ability, you should pick this Talent to increase
your burst damage. When trying to kill
an enemy Hero, cast Righteousness
before using Judgment,
so that the Shield will expire sooner and, as a consequence,
the explosion will happen earlier.
?
Divine Vigor
(Level 4)
Tyrael
If Smite hits an enemy, Tyrael's Basic Attacks within the next 4 seconds heal for 70% of the damage dealt.
Divine Vigor is a good Talent that makes your Basic Attacks
leech for a few seconds when hitting enemy Heroes with Smite,
allowing you to constantly heal based on the damage you deal via Basic Attacks.
To get the most out of this Talent, you should only pick it together with
Purge Evil at Level 7. To further increase its
value, you could theoretically combine it with Seal of El'druin
at Level 20, however, most Level 20 Talents are generally way better than that.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
✔
Burning Halo
(Level 7)
Tyrael
Both Tyrael and El'druin deal 12 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Teleporting increases this damage from Tyrael by 125% for 2 seconds.
Burning Halo is a great Talent that causes both Tyrael
and the sword created by casting El'druin's Might to deal
constant area of effect damage. Reactivating
El'druin's Might to teleport increases the damage
that comes from Tyrael for a couple of seconds.
If you have Sword of Justice at Level 13, the sword
you leave behind also deals constant area of effect
damage. Reactivating El'druin's Might to teleport
does not increase the damage that comes from the sword.
If you have Holy Ground at Level 13, the sword
should be not be placed in the middle of the wave of Minions you are
trying to clear. Instead, you should cast it either in front of enemy
Melee Minions or behind enemy Ranged Minions when trying to clear them,
so that you end up grouping them instead of splitting them.
Each tick of damage done by this Talent increases the healing provided by
Ardent Restoration at Level 1, until it's fully stacked,
resulting in more healing at the beginning of each fight. Note that both Tyrael
and the sword on the ground contribute to ramping up the healing amount.
While this Talent is generally good, you should definitely pick it when
playing as Offlaner because it increases your
waveclear. When safe to do so, position in
a way that allows you to be near enemy Minions after both teleports.
?
Purge Evil
(Level 7)
Tyrael
Each enemy Hero hit by Smite increases Tyrael's Basic Attack damage by 60% for 4 seconds.
Purge Evil is a good Talent that increases your Attack Damage
for a few seconds after casting Smite on enemy Heroes.
The more enemy Heroes you hit, the higher the bonus damage will be.
By doing more damage with your Basic Attacks, you will also get more healing
from Divine Vigor at Level 4. If you combine this Talent
with Smite the Wicked at Level 16, you will be able to
trigger this Talent more often. If you pair this Talent
with Seal of El'druin at Level 20, you will get more value
per Smite's cast.
We find this Talent to be great when playing Tyrael as a Flex,
so like a Melee Assassin in the 4-man,
because it increases your damage at the cost of waveclear
(which is extremely important when playing as Offlaner)
or utility (which is nice to have when playing as Tank).
?
Swift Retribution
(Level 7)
Tyrael
Smite grants 20% more Movement Speed and also grants 25% Attack Speed for 2 seconds.
Swift Retribution is a strong Talent that empowers
the buff area created by Smite:
Tyreal and the allied Heroes affected gain more Movement Speed and
also have their Attack Speed increased for 2 seconds.
The additional Movement Speed provided by this Talent is useful
for helping allied Heroes chase enemy Heroes,
reposition during team fights, retreat when in danger, or move
towards Sanctification when used.
When pushing, you can use Smite
on allied Minions to buff their Movement Speed
and Attack Speed, thus dealing more damage to enemy Structures.
You can use this Talent to better enable allied Heroes who lack
mobility (such as Alarak), to further
empower Heroes who rely on Basic Attacks (like Valla),
or to do both at the same time (notably Sgt. Hammer).

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Judgment
(Level 10)
Tyrael
Mana: 80
Cooldown: 70 seconds
After 0.75 seconds, charge an enemy Hero, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds. Nearby enemies are knocked away and take 75 (+4% per level) damage.
Judgment is a good Heroic Ability that, after being
channeled for 0.75 seconds, allows Tyrael to quickly close the gap
with a target enemy Hero. The target takes damage and is Stunned.
Allies nearby the target take some damage too and are Knocked back.
Last but not the least, Tyrael becomes Unstoppable while
charging towards the target.
Tyrael with Judgment can be paired with another
dive Hero (for example Illidan with
The Hunt) or with a long-range
burst damage Ability (such as
Falstad with Hinterland Blast)
to easily get a kill in the enemy backline.
Pick it when you need a better engage, when you want
to dive the enemy backline,
or you really need an interrupt for a powerful
Heroic Ability, otherwise you will lose too many team fights because
the enemy team will be free to channel it.
?
Sanctification
(Level 10)
Tyrael
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 85 seconds
After 0.5 seconds create a field of holy energy that makes allied Heroes Invulnerable. Lasts 3 seconds.
Sanctification is a strong Heroic Ability that, after being
channeled for 0.5 seconds, creates a buff area
on the ground: Tyrael and allied Heroes who are standing in it
are Invulnerable.
Pick it when your team needs more protection in team fights because your team
is diving, the enemy team is diving, you are playing against
a powerful crowd control effects, or the enemy team
relies on a wombo-combo to win team fights.
Keep in mind that some Heroes with Time Stop
(only Medivh, Mei, and Zeratul can do it,
with Ley Line Seal, Ice Wall,
and Void Prison respectively) can nullify it.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
✔
Sword of Justice
(Level 13)
Tyrael
Upon teleporting using El'druin's Might, El'druin swaps places with Tyrael, and El'druin's Might can be reactivated to teleport an additional time.
Sword of Justice is a good Talent that leaves a sword behind
when reactivating El'druin's Might to teleport the first time,
allowing you to reactivate it again to teleport a second time. The first teleport
will move you where you threw the sword, the second teleport will move you
back where you were when teleporting the first time.
You can use this Talent to deal poke damage and bait
several Abilities onto you, only to teleport back to your original location.
This playstyle requires expertise and experience as otherwise Tyrael
may get caught by several crowd control effects
preventing him from teleporting back. If you happen to get caught,
you can hold the [Q] key to ensure El'druin's Might's
reactivation goes off as soon as possible.
Burning Halo at Level 7
deals damage to enemies around the sword you leave behind and deals bonus
damage even after you reactivate El'druin's Might
to teleport back. Similarly, when you teleport back,
Bound by Law at Level 16 applies an empowered
Slow to nearby enemies.
When you cannot hold your teleport for them, the sword you leave behind
also counts for Stalwart Angel at Level 4,
giving you more Armor uptime,
and for Smite the Wicked at Level 16,
resulting in more Smite's cooldown reduction.
?
Holy Ground
(Level 13)
Tyrael
Create a ring for 3 seconds that blocks enemies from entering the area teleported to using El'druin's Might.
Holy Ground is a good Talent that creates a circle
of impassable terrain in the location
where Tyrael appears when teleporting with El'druin's Might,
pushing enemy Heroes away and preventing them from entering the area.
This effect is great on Maps where Boss Camps are a
win condition and does well on Maps where narrow
corridors are present. Furthermore, regardless of the Map you are
playing on, it can be used to peel from
melee Heroes and/or to annoy enemy Heroes
who lack mobility as you will be able to
body-block them with ease.
You should always pair this Talent with Horadric Reforging
at Level 16 because it allows you to cast El'druin's Might
more often. When contesting a Boss Camp, this means
you can always have Holy Ground active
or El'druin's Might ready to immediately
secure the Capture Point.
?
Law and Order
(Level 13)
Tyrael
Each enemy Hero hit by Smite reduces the cooldown of Righteousness by 1 second. Each allied Hero Shielded by Righteousness increases the damage of the next Smite by 35%.
Law and Order is a good Talent with two complementary
effects: hitting enemy Heroes with Smite reduces
Righteousness's cooldown; using
Righteousness to Shield allied Heroes
other than Tyrael increases next Smite's damage.
To get value from Righteousness's cooldown reduction,
you should ideally use Smite after
Righteousness, otherwise you will waste it.
If you need Righteousness to save someone,
however, do not worry about the synergy.
To get more value from Smite's damage increase,
you should ideally use Righteousness on as many
allied Heroes as possible. Remember that Tyrael does not count,
so you will get no value from it when alone.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
✔
Bound by Law
(Level 16)
Tyrael
El'Druin's Might's Slow is increased to 65% for 1 second, decaying to 30% over the remaining duration.
Bound by Law is a strong Talent that increases the
Slow applied by El'druin's Might
when Tyrael teleports by reactivating it. The second reactivation
provided by Sword of Justice at Level 13
is empowered by this Talent as well, if an enemy Hero happens
to be near the sword you leave behind with the first teleport.
While it does not increase your damage output, this Talent
helps you peel for allied Heroes
and helps you and your teammates damage enemy Heroes as
they will have a harder time dodging
or running away while Slowed.
?
Horadric Reforging
(Level 16)
Tyrael
Tyrael's Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of El'druin's Might by 2 seconds.
Horadric Reforging is a good Talent that
reduces El'druin's Might's cooldown when
hitting enemies with Basic Attacks, increasing your
mobility.
Thanks to the cooldown reduction provided, this Talent is good
when paired with Stalwart Angel at Level 4 because
it will give you more Armor uptime,
with Burning Halo at Level 7 because it gives you more bonus damage
uptime as you will be able to reactivate El'druin's Might more often,
and with Holy Ground at Level 13 because it allows you
to create impassable terrain
for blocking enemy Heroes more often and, more importantly, to make
the Capture Point of a Boss Camp
inaccessible to enemy Heroes for longer.
?
Smite the Wicked
(Level 16)
Tyrael
While El'druin's Might is active, and for 2 seconds after teleporting, Smite's cooldown recharges 125% faster.
Smite the Wicked is a good Talent that makes
Smite's cooldown recharge faster while
El'druin's Might's sword is on the ground
and 2 seconds after it disappears.
If you do not have Sword of Justice at Level 13,
you can maximize the bonus provided by this Talent by using
El'druin's Might at close distance
and not teleporting until the end of its duration. Note that playing
this way comes at the cost of mobility.
If you have Sword of Justice at Level 13,
you can freely use El'druin's Might at a
distance and teleport immediately as the sword you leave
behind will count for Smite the Wicked.
Note that playing this way does not reduce your
mobility.
Being able to cast Smite more often
has synergy with Divine Vigor at Level 4
and Purge Evil at Level 7 because you will
get more healing and more damage from them.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Tyrael
talent_pages.text:
✔
Angel of Justice
(Level 20)
Tyrael
Increases the cast range of Judgment by 50%, and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.
Angel of Justice is a strong Talent which increases
Judgment's range and reduces is cooldown, making it
more threatening, intimidating, and slightly harder to counter.
If you have Sword of Justice at Level 13, you can
bait some Heroic Abilities with it: use El'druin's Might
in a safe spot, cast Judgment, and reactivate
El'druin's Might to teleport back. After that,
wait 30 seconds for Judgment's cooldown
and then go for a real engage while any
Heroic Abilities they used to stop you earlier are on cooldown.
?
Holy Arena
(Level 20)
Tyrael
Increase the duration of Sanctification by 1 second and increase the damage of allies inside by 25%.
Holy Arena is a strong Talent that will not only extend
Sanctification's duration but will also increase
the damage of all allied Heroes inside it, turning a powerful defensive cooldown
into a powerful defensive and offensive one.
With this Talent, you can win almost any team fight by just
activating Sanctification when your team is together.
Similarly, it is excellent when going for an enemy Keep or for their Core
because the enemy team will not be able to do anything against your team while
everyone does much more damage to the Structure, easily destroying it.
?
Seal of El'druin
(Level 20)
Tyrael
Using a Basic Ability grants 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.
Seal of El'druin is a decent Talent which greatly increases
your Attack Speed for a few seconds whenever you use a Basic Ability, boosting
your single-target damage when you are allowed to stick on enemy Heroes,
when fighting Mercenaries, or when hitting enemy Structures.
Assuming you do not need anything else in this Tier,
we find this Talent interesting if you previously picked
Divine Vigor at Level 4 and
Purge Evil at Level 7 because you will
get more healing and more damage from them.
?
Defense of the Angels
(Level 20)
Tyrael
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to gain 50 Armor for 3 seconds.
Each time Tyrael damages an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Basic Ability, increase the duration of this Armor bonus by 0.5 seconds.
Defense of the Angels is a situational Talent that can be activated
to gain a high amount of Armor, protecting Tyrael from incoming damage
for a few seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks or Basic Abilities extend the
buff's duration.
When Sanctification gets interrupted,
you can use Defense of the Angels to take less damage
for a few seconds while you wait for the 10-second cooldown to end.
Note that allied Heroes will have no protection when that happens.
You can pick this Talent when you need to increase your own survivability against
burst damage. Remember that you need to activate it before
you get crowd controlled, otherwise you could end
up dying without having a chance to use it.
?
Aspect of Justice
(Level 20)
Tyrael
After 1.25 seconds, gain the effects of Archangel's Wrath without dying. Cooldown is reduced by 15% for each enemy Hero hit by the explosion.
Aspect of Justice is a situational Talent that can be
activated for temporarily turning Tyrael into an Archangel, similar to when
he dies and Archangel's Wrath goes off, reducing the
damage done by enemy Heroes and damaging all enemies hit by the explosion,
but in this case you are alive and the explosion does not reduce your Death Timer.
Keep in mind that activating your Trait this way has a 1.25-second
channel which makes it vulnerable to
interrupts.
When Sanctification gets interrupted,
you can use Aspect of Justice to take no damage
for a few seconds and reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes
while you wait for the 10-second cooldown to end.
We find this Talent useful as a counter to delayed damage
(like Pyroblast by Kael'thas)
or delayed crowd control effects
(notably Temporal Loop by Chromie)
because you have enough time to channel it.
